L Ld VDD n3

rationale: The proposed topology improves the noise figure and gain margins by incorporating a source inductor (Ls) in series with the NMOS source, enhancing input matching and noise performance through inductive degeneration while maintaining low power and stability. This adjustment targets the binding constraints (NF and S21) without degrading S11 or power, leveraging the 45nm process’s ability to support small inductors for tuning. The inductor provides impedance transformation that improves the input match and reduces the effective source resistance seen by the gate, directly lowering NF and boosting forward gain.
